content:
I regret buying this foam mattress because it started sagging within just a few weeks.  
The so-called support is terrible, and I wake up every morning with back pain.  
It also sleeps much hotter than advertised, making it uncomfortable through the night.  
There was a strong chemical smell when I opened it, and it lingered far longer than expected.  
The edges are weak, so sitting or lying near the side feels unstable.  
It didn’t expand evenly after unpacking, leaving odd lumps and dips across the surface.  
For the price, I expected much better quality and durability.  
I would not recommend this mattress to anyone looking for comfort or value.
